# Beta114 — interactive trends and direct room navigation

## Room dashboard

- Average trends support inspecting recorded values and timestamps, selectable
  time ranges, earlier/later navigation, and keyboard and touch interaction.
  Missing-data gaps remain visible; single-sensor readings retain native Home
  Assistant history and multi-sensor means retain their contributor links.
- A settings button immediately left of each room name opens that room's
  configuration form. Opening or cancelling the form does not save changes.
  Submitted changes use Home Assistant's existing room validation.
- Room names use occupied, empty and unknown colours based on verified room
  evidence, including rooms without an enabled climate controller. Verified
  whole-home absence takes priority over stale room presence.
- The no-occupancy indicator now includes away information; the separate
  away/absence icon has been removed.
- Room overview warning and information buttons open the relevant details:
  missing sensor data, windows, ventilation advice, controller status or
  physical-device errors. Room and device folds open as needed, with keyboard
  focus placed on the selected problem.

## Repository cleanup

The explicitly requested cleanup removed all 130 tags older than
`v0.6.0b113`. Beta113 and newer tags are retained. The repository continues
to use only `main` and `dev`.

## Validation and update

The release pipeline validates the exact promoted commit, including the new
room navigation, settings and trend interactions, the existing backend and
browser regressions, and the installation ZIP. Device control behavior is
unchanged by the card work; the new room presence snapshot is display data.

Install this beta through HACS, restart Home Assistant, and refresh the
dashboard to load the bundled card. The ZIP asset supports manual installation.
